firm_data.firm_description: Floyd Zadkovich is an international commercial law firm focusing on international trade and maritime sectors, with experience in energy, commodities, logistics, shipping, and insurance. They provide disputes advice and bespoke advisory services.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in Houston, Sydney, Chicago, London, and New York.
They offer cross-jurisdictional capabilities, particularly for matters involving substantive law in one jurisdiction and security/enforcement proceedings in another.
The firm's managing partner, Luke Zadkovich, co-hosts the legal podcast, Case by Case.

email.subject: AI for Floyd Zadkovich, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Luke,

Your cross-jurisdictional setup across Houston, Sydney, Chicago, London, and New York puts Floyd Zadkovich in a unique position, but it also means coordinating maritime and trade disputes across multiple legal systems simultaneously. That's exactly the complexity we see slowing down firms in your space.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how our ex-lawyer team is helping similar firms compete with BigLaw, especially on document-heavy disputes and cross-border matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
